request.task: Decide whether the database schema migration is sufficiently supported as safe for rolling deployment.
required_information: Evidence must cover mixed old/new application versions during the rolling window.
Evidence must establish backfill completeness and data invariants after migration.
Evidence must establish a viable recovery/rollback or forward-fix path for the migration state.

artifact.task: Fresh evidence-sufficiency holdout v1: Decide whether the database schema migration is sufficiently supported as safe for rolling deployment.

evidence.observation: Mixed-version compatibility tests pass with old and new application versions reading/writing the migrated schema.
Backfill reconciliation reports zero missing rows and all post-migration invariants hold.
A recovery rehearsal successfully restores service from the post-migration state without data loss.

label: sufficient
rationale: Rolling compatibility, backfill integrity, and recovery behavior are all directly evidenced.
